modules-for-updating-a-holding-and-termi.text: Modules for updating a holding and terminating its key on the proved design.

Issue 743. This page places the new and changed code and fixes its dependency direction. Records are in the data model and signatures in the functions model. The components issue 742 created are in its modules model; this page names only what changes.

changed-components.text: Paths are proposals. When the aligned Lean models name a component differently, the code takes the model's name, and the mandate is versioned before the slice that creates it starts.

dependency-direction.text: Singular never depends on open datum. Open datum learns the state policy and the registry name as data from its own holding's protected control, never from a compiled hash.
